1. (Currently amended) A control system comprising: a controller including a processor and memory, the controller configured to be communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components by generating and storing holistic state data in the memory, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining, using the processor, a mathematical model configured to describe the process used by the controller; determining, using the processor, input and output variables of the process; determining, using the processor, constraints on the input and output variables; determining, using the processor, an objective function associated with the process used by the controller; and storing the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in the holistic state data stored in the memory to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data, wherein the holistic state data is transmitted to the automation components to control physical operations of the automation components in the process.

2. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and to communicate the holistic state data to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network, wherein the automation components execute control actions based on the holistic state data to perform the process.

3. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane and to communicate the holistic state data to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane, wherein the automation components execute control actions based on the holistic state data to perform the process.

4. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is a standardized format understood by each of the automation components, and wherein the standardized format enables interoperability between the controller and the automation components to control physical operations of the automation components.

5. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining, using the processor, an intermediate search result of an optimization search; determining, using the processor, a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and storing the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data, wherein the optimization search controls physical operations of the automation components.

6. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system, wherein the optimization search determines control actions for the automation components to perform the process.

7. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining, using the processor, computational capabilities of the controller; determining, using the processor, interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and storing the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data, wherein the computational capabilities and interconnections are used to control physical operations of the automation components.

8. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to communicate the holistic state data to a server in the control system via the communication network to facilitate determining an optimization problem, wherein the server determines control actions for the automation components based on the optimization problem.

9. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data in the memory.

10. (Currently amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise instructions to: receive, using the processor, control system configuration data; determine, using the processor, automation components communicatively coupled to the controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data; determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components; and instruct, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on the optimization problem and causes the automation components to perform physical operations in the process.

11. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components, and wherein the optimization problem determines control actions that cause the automation components to perform physical operations.

12. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing capabilities of each of the automation components, and wherein the optimization problem determines control actions that cause the automation components to perform physical operations.

13. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data corresponds with one of the automation components, and wherein the holistic state data is used to determine control actions for the automation components.

14. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data to extract information used to control the automation components.

15. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data comprises a standardized format with same fields, and wherein the standardized format enables the processor to determine control actions for the automation components.

16. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud server via a network connection, and wherein the configuration data is used to determine control actions for the automation components.

17. (Currently amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: determining, using a processor, holistic state data captured by a controller in the control system; simulating, using the processor, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations; analyzing, using the processor, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller; and adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics, wherein the adjusting comprises modifying control actions executed by automation components in the control system.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein: simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller; and analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions on physical operations of automation components in the control system.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein analyzing the simulation comprises: determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using a model; and comparing the predicted response with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model, wherein the predicted and actual responses relate to physical operations of automation components.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary, wherein the adjusted model is used to determine control actions for automation components in the control system.
